mitigation_cards.name: Winner-protection confirmation gate
mitigation_cards.hypothesis: False cuts are high because exits trigger before confirmation loss of momentum.
mitigation_cards.paper_rule: Apply mitigation if candidate exit and post-trigger confirmation fails to break local continuation for two bars.
mitigation_cards.risk: May delay exits on true failures.

mitigation_cards.name: Tiered trigger throttling
mitigation_cards.hypothesis: Trigger density is too broad; high trigger rate captures many eventual winners.
mitigation_cards.paper_rule: Throttle candidate exits by priority tier and only allow full trigger set in top-risk slices.
mitigation_cards.risk: Could under-capture tail loss in non-top-risk trades.

mitigation_cards.name: Selective trial deactivation plan
mitigation_cards.hypothesis: Trials P12-T1 and P12-T3 contribute most to winner cuts; isolate safer subset first.
mitigation_cards.paper_rule: Use P12-T2 as anchor and re-introduce other trials only after pair-specific false-cut compliance.
